title: Common Adverbs of Time, Place and Manner
lede: Recognise and use high-frequency adverbs to say when, where and how everyday actions happen.

blocks: ## Why adverbs matter لِمَاذَا تَهُمُّ الظُّرُوفُ؟
A verb tells us what happens. Adverbs and adverbial phrases add the practical information listeners and readers need: when, where and how.
### Core
Recognise and use high-frequency time, place and manner words.
### Develop
Place adverbs naturally and distinguish an adjective from an adverb.
### Stretch
Notice how place words govern a following genitive noun and how emphasis changes word order.
[callout] Communication test: after reading a sentence, can you answer when? , where? or how? in Arabic?
## Diagnostic start
Try first. The explanations will then repair any uncertainty.
## Adverbs of time ظُرُوفُ الزَّمَانِ
These words locate an action on a timeline. They may appear near the beginning or end of a sentence, depending on emphasis.

TABLE: Arabic | Meaning | Model in context // الْيَوْمَ | today | أَدْرُسُ الْعَرَبِيَّةَ الْيَوْمَ. // أَمْسِ | yesterday | زُرْتُ صَدِيقِي أَمْسِ. // غَدًا | tomorrow | سَأَعْمَلُ غَدًا. // الآنَ | now | أَقْرَأُ الآنَ. // قَرِيبًا | soon | سَنَبْدَأُ قَرِيبًا. // دَائِمًا / غَالِبًا / أَحْيَانًا / نَادِرًا | always / often / sometimes / rarely | أَذْهَبُ إِلَى النَّادِي أَحْيَانًا.
[example] غَدًا سَأَذْهَبُ إِلَى السُّوقِ. ⇄ سَأَذْهَبُ إِلَى السُّوقِ غَدًا.
[ar] غَدًا سَأَذْهَبُ إِلَى السُّوقِ.
[ar] سَأَذْهَبُ إِلَى السُّوقِ غَدًا.
[callout] Both orders are possible. Fronting غَدًا highlights the time. Placing it later keeps the verb first and often sounds neutral.
## Adverbs and expressions of place ظُرُوفُ الْمَكَانِ
Some place words stand alone; others are followed by a noun that completes the location.
### Stand-alone place words
هُنَا — here هُنَاكَ — there دَاخِلًا — inside خَارِجًا — outside
أَسْكُنُ هُنَا، وَلَكِنَّ مَدْرَسَتِي هُنَاكَ.
### Place word + noun
فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ تَحْتَ الْكُرْسِيِّ أَمَامَ الْمَدْرَسَةِ خَلْفَ الْبَيْتِ بَيْنَ الْمَكْتَبَيْنِ
The following noun is genitive because the phrase behaves like an iḍāfa-style location expression.
[callout/warning] Common error: not فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةُ , but فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ .
## Adverbs of manner كَيْفَ يَحْدُثُ الْفِعْلُ؟
Manner tells us how an action happens. Some common forms end in fatḥatayn; other meanings use a prepositional phrase.
### Single-word manner
جَيِّدًا — well سَرِيعًا — quickly فَجْأَةً — suddenly مَعًا — together وَحْدَهُ / وَحْدَهَا — alone
### Phrase-based manner
بِبُطْءٍ — slowly بِهُدُوءٍ — calmly بِوُضُوحٍ — clearly بِعِنَايَةٍ — carefully
Lesson 3 develops these phrases fully.
[example] سَيَّارَةٌ سَرِيعَةٌ ≠ تَسِيرُ السَّيَّارَةُ سَرِيعًا
[ar] سَيَّارَةٌ سَرِيعَةٌ
[ar] تَسِيرُ السَّيَّارَةُ سَرِيعًا
[callout] Adjective versus adverb: سَرِيعَةٌ describes the noun سَيَّارَةٌ ; سَرِيعًا describes the action تَسِيرُ .
## Apply through four skills
### 📖 Reading detective
أَسْتَيْقِظُ مُبَكِّرًا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ. أَدْرُسُ هُنَا فِي غُرْفَتِي، وَأَكْتُبُ وَاجِبِي بِعِنَايَةٍ. غَدًا سَأَدْرُسُ مَعَ صَدِيقَتِي هُنَاكَ فِي الْمَكْتَبَةِ.
Sort the highlighted ideas into time, place and manner. Then explain which verb each one modifies.
### 🎧 Listening reconstruction
Ask a partner to read the paragraph twice. On the first hearing, write only the verbs. On the second, add when, where and how.
### 🗣️ Speaking grid
Describe three actions. Each answer must include one time, one place and one manner expression.
### 🛠️ Misconception clinic
Repair: هَذَا قِطَارٌ سَرِيعًا , الْحَقِيبَةُ تَحْتَ الْكُرْسِيُّ , and تَكَلَّمَ جَيِّدٌ . Explain each correction.
### ✍️ Everyday action description
Write 80–100 words about one ordinary day. Include at least four time expressions, three place expressions and three manner expressions.
[callout] Model: الْيَوْمَ أَسْتَيْقِظُ مُبَكِّرًا، ثُمَّ أَدْرُسُ هُنَا فِي غُرْفَتِي. أَكْتُبُ بِعِنَايَةٍ وَأَقْرَأُ جَيِّدًا.
[callout] Success checklist: Use accurate verb forms; distinguish adjective and adverb; check genitive nouns after place expressions; vary the position of at least two time expressions.
Save and mark complete Clear
Plan a timeline, place map or sentence flowchart, then label it in Arabic with the target adverbs.
Complete the same task on paper. Circle each adverb or adverbial phrase and draw an arrow to the verb or sentence it modifies.
## Final mastery check اِخْتِبَارُ الْإِتْقَانِ
Complete without reopening the teaching tables.
### Today you can
- identify time, place and manner information;
- use common adverbs in meaningful sentences;
- distinguish an adjective from a manner adverb;
- build location phrases with correct genitive forms.
Below 70%: revisit the category that caused most errors. 70–89%: replay the game and rewrite three sentences. 90–100%: continue to time frames.
